name: Canonical Platform — E2E Contract Test Harness

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const cases=Array.isArray(b.cases)?b.cases:[]; const routing={'lead.created':'lead-seller','seller.qualified':'lead-seller','underwriting.requested':'underwriting-risk','underwriting.approved':'underwriting-risk','offer.prepare':'negotiation-offer','offer.accepted':'negotiation-offer','contract.readiness.requested':'contract-esignature','contract.signed':'contract-esignature','buyer.disposition.requested':'buyer-disposition','buyer.locked':'buyer-disposition','title.order.requested':'title-closing','title.cleared':'title-closing','closing.ready':'title-closing','closing.completed':'title-closing','financials.reconcile.requested':'financials-analytics','financials.reconciled':'financials-analytics','profit.realized':'financials-analytics'}; const out=cases.map(c=>{const engine=routing[String(c.eventType||'').toLowerCase()]||'unknown'; const hasIdentity=Boolean(c.leadId||c.dealId||c.propertyId||c.buyerId||c.portfolioId||!(c.missing||[]).includes('leadId')); const terminal=['closed','cancelled','disputed'].includes(String(c.dealStatus||'').toLowerCase()); const action=c.expectedAction||'route'; const actualAction=(!hasIdentity)?'validation_blocked':(terminal?'protected_state_blocked':(action==='replay_blocked'?'replay_blocked':'route')); const routePass=engine===c.expectedEngine; const actionPass=!c.expectedAction||actualAction===c.expectedAction; return {...c,actualEngine:engine,actualAction,passed:routePass&&actionPass,routePass,actionPass};}); const passed=out.filter(x=>x.passed).length; return [{json:{status:passed===out.length?'passed':'failed',total:out.length,passed,failed:out.length-passed,cases:out,testedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

meta.purpose: Deterministic local contract harness for canonical event routing. It validates routing expectations without claiming live InsulaCRM/provider connectivity.
